UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'Justin Benson, Aaron Moorhead (showrunner: Eric Martin)',
  `cast` = 'Tom Hiddleston as Loki, Sophia Di Martino as Sylvie, Owen Wilson as Mobius, Ke Huy Quan as Ouroboros (O.B.), Jonathan Majors as Victor Timely, Gugu Mbatha-Raw as Ravonna Renslayer',
  tagline = 'Glorious purpose fulfilled. Loki becomes the God of Stories — and saves the multiverse.',
  description = 'Loki Season 2 follows the God of Mischief as he time-slips uncontrollably through the TVA, racing to save the organization and the multiverse from collapse while confronting the true nature of free will and sacrifice.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/loki-s2-featured-DQmFqCcnxJ8iJnBULrYnrR.webp',
  episodeCount = 6, seasonCount = 2, platform = 'Disney+',
  rtCriticsScore = 89, rtAudienceScore = 90, verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Loki Season 2 Cards: The God of Stories Premium

Loki Season 2 cards are among the most valuable Disney+ era cards because the finale — Loki becoming the God of Stories and holding the multiverse together — is one of the MCU''s most iconic moments. Ke Huy Quan''s O.B. cards carry the Oscar-winner premium, and the finale''s throne imagery makes for stunning card artwork.',
  keyCards = '- **2024 Upper Deck Loki S2 God of Stories Finale** — Iconic throne moment, $20-50
- **2024 Upper Deck Loki S2 Ke Huy Quan/O.B.** — Oscar winner MCU debut, $10-25
- **2024 Upper Deck Loki S2 Tom Hiddleston Auto** — Series finale autograph, $200-500+
- **2024 Upper Deck Loki S2 Victor Timely** — Kang variant card, $8-20',
  content = '## The Perfect Ending

Loki Season 2 accomplished something almost unheard of in the MCU — it gave a character a definitive, emotionally satisfying ending. Tom Hiddleston''s Loki went from the villain of The Avengers to literally holding the multiverse together on a throne of timelines. It was the greatest character arc in Marvel history, and the finale left fans in tears.

## Ke Huy Quan Steals the Show

Fresh off his Oscar win for Everything Everywhere All at Once, Ke Huy Quan brought infectious energy to Ouroboros (O.B.), the TVA''s forgotten engineer. His chemistry with the entire cast and his genuine enthusiasm made O.B. an instant fan-favorite.

## The Sacrifice

Loki''s final choice — to destroy the Temporal Loom and personally hold every timeline together for eternity — was the culmination of 15 years of character development. The God of Mischief became the God of Stories, alone on a throne at the end of time, keeping the multiverse alive through sheer will. It was beautiful, tragic, and perfect.

## Fun Facts

- Tom Hiddleston has said this is the ending Loki deserved
- Ke Huy Quan was cast specifically because of his Everything Everywhere performance
- The finale''s green throne imagery became instantly iconic in fan art
- The season was filmed back-to-back with Season 1 using the same TVA sets
- Jonathan Majors'' legal issues led to the Kang storyline being quietly concluded here',
  metaDescription = 'Loki Season 2 (2023) guide — God of Stories finale, Ke Huy Quan, the perfect MCU ending, trading card values, and why this is Marvel''s best character arc.',
  keywords = 'loki season 2, god of stories, tom hiddleston, ke huy quan, tva, multiverse, disney plus marvel, marvel cards, finale',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Loki Season 2 God of Stories cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Loki Season 2 the end of Loki''s story?","answer":"Yes, Season 2 provides a definitive ending for Loki''s character arc. Tom Hiddleston has indicated this is the conclusion of Loki''s journey, though the character''s sacrifice has ongoing implications for the multiverse."},{"question":"What is the God of Stories?","answer":"In the finale, Loki destroys the Temporal Loom and personally holds all timelines together, becoming the God of Stories — a being who sits at the end of time keeping the multiverse alive through his sacrifice."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'loki-season-2-2023';

UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'Bryan Andrews (showrunner: A.C. Bradley)',
  `cast` = 'Jeffrey Wright as The Watcher, various MCU voice actors',
  tagline = 'Infinite possibilities. More multiverse adventures from Marvel''s animated anthology.',
  description = 'What If...? Season 2 continues exploring alternate timelines in the multiverse with new scenarios including a 1602 universe, Nebula joining Nova Corps, and the return of Captain Carter.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/what-if-s2-featured-jLN7Xd5LLqKbXCVqDjvJTy.webp',
  episodeCount = 9, seasonCount = 2, platform = 'Disney+',
  rtCriticsScore = 84, rtAudienceScore = 60, verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## What If S2 Cards: Expanded Multiverse Collectibles

Season 2 cards expand the alternate universe card pool with new variants. The 1602 universe cards and Kahhori (a new original character) cards are the standouts. Captain Carter''s continued appearances make her cards from both seasons a cohesive collection.',
  keyCards = '- **2024 Upper Deck What If S2 Kahhori** — Original MCU character debut, $5-15
- **2024 Upper Deck What If S2 1602 Universe** — Unique historical variant cards, $5-12
- **2024 Upper Deck What If S2 Captain Carter** — Continued fan-favorite, $5-15',
  content = '## More Multiverse Adventures

What If Season 2 expanded the animated multiverse with increasingly creative scenarios. The 1602 episode reimagined Marvel heroes in Elizabethan times, while the introduction of Kahhori — a Mohawk woman who gains powers from the Tesseract — represented Marvel''s first original animated character created specifically for the MCU.

## Kahhori: A New Original Hero

Kahhori was significant as the first character created specifically for the MCU rather than adapted from comics. Her story — a Mohawk woman in a world where the Tesseract landed in pre-colonial America — was praised for its Indigenous representation and creative world-building.

## Fun Facts

- Season 2 was released all at once rather than weekly
- Kahhori was created in consultation with Mohawk cultural advisors
- The 1602 episode adapted Neil Gaiman''s Marvel 1602 comic
- Several episodes set up plot threads for the Season 3 finale',
  metaDescription = 'What If...? Season 2 (2023) guide — new multiverse stories, Kahhori debut, 1602 universe, trading card values, and the animated MCU expands.',
  keywords = 'what if season 2, kahhori, captain carter, 1602, the watcher, disney plus marvel, animated, marvel cards, multiverse',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel What If Season 2 cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Who is Kahhori?","answer":"Kahhori is the first original character created specifically for the MCU (not adapted from comics). She is a Mohawk woman who gains powers from the Tesseract in an alternate timeline where it landed in pre-colonial America."},{"question":"Is What If Season 2 connected to Season 1?","answer":"Yes, Season 2 continues some threads from Season 1, particularly Captain Carter''s story, and both seasons feed into the Season 3 finale."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'what-if-season-2-2023'
